decision: All data sync commands (GitHub, Jira, Confluence) run as standalone Node.js scripts invoked via `npm run sync:*`; they write to SQLite directly and do not run inside the Next.js server process.
key_insight: All data sync commands (GitHub, Jira, Confluence) run as standalone Node.js scripts invoked via `npm run sync:*`; they write to SQLite directly and do not run inside the Next.js server process.
alternatives_considered: API route at /api/sync that triggers the import inline
rejected_reason: Inline sync inside a web request ties HTTP timeout limits to potentially long import operations
